nativeTotalMs.label: Mean reported total time
nativeTotalMs.scope: SVO total means are the source-reported sum of frontend and backend means; their total SD is unavailable. Other rows retain the implementation-specific reported native timing boundary. Neither definition establishes end-to-end latency.

reportedCpuPercent.label: Mean reported host CPU
reportedCpuPercent.scope: Source excludes the monitor initialization row. Cross-platform normalization is not verified; values above 100 are retained.

reportedProcessMemoryMiB.label: Mean reported process memory
reportedProcessMemoryMiB.scope: Source VINS/process memory; RSS/PSS identity is not independently established.
